title:
Shellfish Bulletin 
           
            Shellfishes collected and tested from
             Dumanquillas Bay  in Zamboanga del Sur;
             Tantanang Bay  in Zamboanga Sibugay Province;  and Matarinao Bay in Eastern Samar  are still  positive  for paralytic Shellfish Poison (PSP) or toxic red tide that is beyond the regulatory limit.  Moreover, coastal waters of Zumarraga Island in Samar are now positive for PSP .
